title: granvik-prior: Granvik 2018 debiased population prior
description: Implement Granvik et al. (2018) debiased population model: map orbital elements (a, e, i) to source region probabilities (ν6, 3:1, 5:2, 2:1, Hungaria, Phocaea, JFC). Source region → taxonomy distribution. Every NEO gets a taxonomy prior even without spectral data. This multiplies coverage from ~500 spectrally-characterized NEOs to ~36,000 known NEOs. See PRD Bayesian architecture decision.

title: ssodnet-ingest: supplementary data source
description: Ingest SsODNet (Solar System Open Database Network) as supplementary data. Aggregates physical properties, taxonomy, and dynamical data from multiple catalogs. See PRD §12 Phase 3.

title: recoverability-accessibility: delta-v function + extraction factors
description: Research bead: Define recoverability factor table {material, asteroid_type} → factor (0-1) with rationale. Choose accessibility function form (exponential decay vs sigmoid vs composite). Set scale parameters. Review Sonter 1997, Cannon & Britt 2019, NHATS criteria. Output: scoring/recoverability_accessibility.yaml. See tasks/scoring-recoverability-accessibility-design.md.

title: neowise-ingest: NEOWISE albedo/diameter into physical_properties
description: Ingest NEOWISE pre-computed diameter/albedo table from PDS SBN into physical_properties table. Fields: albedo_pv, albedo_pv_err, diameter_km, diameter_err, beaming_eta. Cross-match by packed/unpacked MPC designation. See PRD §5E.

title: project-setup: pyproject.toml, prospector/ package layout, tests/, pytest config
description: Create pyproject.toml with project metadata and dependencies. Set up prospector/ package with __init__.py and subpackages: ingest/, spectral/, scoring/, ephemeris/. Create tests/ directory mirroring package structure. Configure pytest. Update .gitignore for data files. See PRD §7 Proposed Architecture and §12 Phase 1.

title: Phase 2 — Full Spectral Pipeline + Scoring
description: Add all spectral analysis methods and full scoring formula. Acceptance: confidence score produces sensible orderings, classical+CNN side-by-side, Lambert solver for top-20, full 6-component scoring.

title: scorer: Monte Carlo composite mining score
description: Monte Carlo scorer: sample from distribution priors (grade_density_priors.yaml + Granvik taxonomy distribution). Compute: estimated_mass × grade × recoverability × unit_value × confidence × accessibility. Confidence = posterior width. Support earth_return and in_space scoring modes. Material values configurable via YAML. See PRD §6 US-005.

title: mithneos-ingest: MITHNEOS ASCII spectra into spectra table
description: Ingest MITHNEOS ASCII spectra (wavelength+reflectance two-column text files) into spectra table. Map designation-based filenames (e.g. a004179.sp05.txt) to asteroid_id via entity resolver. Store wavelengths/reflectance as numpy BLOB. Record wl_min, wl_max, survey='MITHNEOS'. See PRD §5E.

title: thermal-depletion-filter: water target viability (Toliou 2021)
description: Filter water-mining candidates by thermal history. Toliou et al. (2021) models show some NEO orbits thermally deplete near-surface volatiles. Penalize or exclude C-type water targets with long low-perihelion residence times. See PRD §12 Phase 3.

title: jwst-water-detection: 6μm molecular H2O integration
description: Integrate JWST 6μm emission feature data (H-O-H bending mode) for unambiguous water detection (Arredondo et al. 2024). Unlike 3μm band, 6μm is exclusively molecular water. Currently ~4 asteroids, expanding to 30+ in Cycle 2+. See PRD §5D.

title: gaia-dr3-ingest: Gaia DR3 visible spectra (volume triage layer)
description: Ingest Gaia DR3 asteroid reflectance spectra (60,518 asteroids, 16 bands, 0.374-1.034μm) via TAP query. Join by number_mp or denomination. Store in spectra table with survey='Gaia'. Note: primarily MBAs, limited NEO coverage. See PRD §5A, §5E.

title: taxonomy-module: Stage 1 Mahlke 2022 classification wrapper
description: Stage 1: Wrap classy package for Mahlke 2022 probabilistic classification. Accept reflectance spectrum (any coverage) + optional NEOWISE albedo. Return 17-class probability vector. Store primary_class, primary_prob, prob_vector (JSON BLOB), classifier name, input_coverage in taxonomy table. Key: M-type asteroids identified from joint spectral-albedo model. See PRD §4 Stage 1.

title: band-analysis: Stage 2 classical band parameter extraction
description: Stage 2: Continuum removal (linear continua tangent to peaks at ~0.7μm and ~1.5μm for Band I, ~1.5μm and ~2.4μm for Band II). Band I/II centers via polynomial fit. Temperature correction (Sanchez 2012). BAR = BII/BI. Dunn et al. (2010) calibration for S(IV): ol/(ol+px) = -0.242×BAR+0.728. Red-edge correction (Lindsay 2015/2016). Gaffey S-subtypes S(I)-S(VII) for non-S(IV). Store in band_analysis table. See PRD §4 Stage 2.

title: output-csv: ranked candidate list with scoring breakdown
description: Generate ranked candidate CSV: asteroid_id, name, taxonomy (with probability), top analog match, estimated composition, estimated mass, PGM confidence tier, value score, accessibility score, composite score, MOID, next close approach. Validate: Itokawa (S-type) and Bennu (B-type) rank sensibly. See PRD FR-8.

title: relab-ingest: RELAB meteorite spectral library
description: Download and index full RELAB PDS archive (~2GB). Parse ASCII spectral files + sample catalog metadata (meteorite name, type, grain size). Build local index mapping sample_id to meteorite type/group. No asteroid ID join — meteorite type maps to taxonomy class conceptually. See PRD §5C.

title: sbdb-ingest: JPL SBDB bulk CSV into asteroids + orbits tables
description: Ingest JPL SBDB bulk CSV into asteroids and orbits tables. Handle missing fields as NULL. Map spkid to asteroid_id. Parse designation, name, full_name, neo/pha flags. Import orbital elements (e, a, i, om, w, ma, epoch), H magnitude, diameter, moid. See PRD §5E for field specs.

title: spectral-preprocessing: Stage 0 normalization and QC
description: Stage 0: Resample spectra to common wavelength grid via interpolation. Normalize to reflectance=1.0 at 550nm. Mask telluric absorption regions (1.35-1.45μm, 1.80-2.00μm for ground-based). Estimate per-channel SNR. Flag low-quality spectra. Set normalized=TRUE and snr_estimate in spectra table. See PRD §4 Stage 0.

title: validate-classy: research spike on classy package
description: Research spike: install classy (Mahlke 2022 taxonomy) package. Verify Python 3.10+ compat. Test API with sample spectrum. Document actual API signatures, input/output formats, required preprocessing. If broken/unmaintained, document fallback to PCA-based Bus-DeMeo classifier. See PRD §11 Risks.

title: spin-barrier-filter: LCDB rotation period constraints
description: Ingest LCDB rotation periods. Fast rotators (P < 2.2 hr) are likely monolithic — easier to mine. Slow rotators with large amplitude may be rubble piles or binaries. Use as scoring modifier. See PRD §5D.

title: confidence-formula: Bayesian posterior confidence scoring
description: Research bead: Design the 8-factor confidence formula combining taxonomy entropy, wavelength coverage, SNR, method agreement (classical vs CNN), taxonomy-analog concordance, supplementary data availability, PGM convergence signals. Choose functional form (geometric mean vs arithmetic vs tiered). Define normalization functions and weights. Validate on Itokawa, Bennu, Psyche, Eros. Output: scoring/confidence_config.yaml. See tasks/scoring-confidence-formula-design.md.

title: scoring-config: grade/density priors from literature review
description: Research bead: Populate scoring/grade_density_priors.yaml from literature. PGM grades from Cannon et al. (2023) — NOT Kargel (1994). Density priors from Carry (2012) with porosity. Water content from Alexander et al. (2012) for C-types. Iron/silicate content per taxonomy class. All values as distributions {mean, std, min, max} for Monte Carlo sampling. Output: YAML with {taxonomy_class → {material: concentration, density, uncertainty}}. See tasks/scoring-grade-and-density-review.md.

title: pgm-convergence: Stage 5 multi-signal PGM identification
description: Stage 5: PGM candidate identification via multi-signal convergence. Combine: M-type taxonomy probability, featureless NIR + reddish slope, absence of 1/2μm bands, iron meteorite analog match, radar albedo, thermal inertia, polarimetry, S-type metal fraction. Assign confidence tiers (Tier 1 High through Tier S S-type metal). See PRD §4 Stage 5.

title: hapke-modeling: Stage 3B radiative transfer forward modeling
description: Stage 3B: Hapke intimate mixture model for top-N candidates. Compute SSA from mineral endmember optical constants (olivine, pyroxene, plagioclase, troilite, Fe-Ni metal). Mix SSAs by cross-sectional area fractions. Add SMFe space weathering (Hapke 2001). Optimize mineral abundances, grain sizes, SMFe via gradient descent. Results with uncertainty ranges — inversion is ill-posed. Key for PGM: distinguishes metal-rich from weathered surfaces. See PRD §4 Stage 3B.

title: schema-design: unified SQLite/DuckDB schema
description: Define unified database schema: asteroids, orbits, physical_properties, spectra, taxonomy, band_analysis, scores tables. Create migration/init script. BLOB columns store numpy arrays via .tobytes()/np.frombuffer(). See PRD §12 Unified Database Schema for exact DDL.

title: phase-curve-analysis: H, G1, G2 from MPC photometry
description: Phase curve analysis using MPC photometry. Fit H, G1, G2 parameters. Constrains surface properties (roughness, porosity). Per commercial cross-reference recommendations. See PRD §12 Phase 3.

title: entity-resolver: cross-survey ID normalization
description: Entity resolution module: normalize IAU number, packed/unpacked MPC designation, SPK-ID across surveys to canonical form. Use MPC packed<->unpacked conversion algorithm. Handle aliases via SBDB alt_des field. Unit-test against 50+ known multi-survey asteroids (Itokawa=25143=1998 SF36, Bennu=101955=1999 RQ36, etc.). See PRD §5E Cross-Survey Entity Resolution.

title: space-weathering-correction: Stage 1B Brunetto model
description: Stage 1B: Apply Brunetto et al. (2006) space weathering correction ONLY to silicate-bearing spectra (S/Q/V/A-complex). Compute Cs parameter via least-squares exponential fit. Do NOT apply to C-complex, M/X-complex, or featureless spectra. Preserve original spectrum for comparison. Apply before band analysis and analog matching. See PRD §4 Stage 1B.

title: curve-matching: Stage 3 meteorite analog matching
description: Stage 3: Match asteroid spectra against RELAB meteorite spectra. Resample to common grid. Apply free scaling + slope adjustment before matching. Compute WMSE and correlation coefficient. Rank by WMSE, reject matches with rho<0.90. Filter matches to meteorite types consistent with taxonomy class (probabilistic). Return top-5 analogs with fit metrics. See PRD §4 Stage 3.

title: smass-ingest: SMASS II visible spectra
description: Ingest SMASS II spectra (1,341 asteroids, 0.44-0.92μm) from smass.mit.edu bulk tar archive. Supplements Gaia for objects not in DR3. Store in spectra table with survey='SMASS'. See PRD §5D.

title: Phase 3 — Advanced Modeling + Extensions
description: Computationally expensive or research-grade capabilities for high-priority candidates. Explicitly aspirational — items can be prioritized independently.

title: lambert-solver: approach window search via Lambert transfers
description: Lambert transfer search over launch windows and time-of-flight bounds. Compute: launch date, arrival date, TOF, departure delta-v (from 200km LEO), arrival delta-v, total mission delta-v. Fast prefilter by MOID, inclination, synodic period. Build on archive/distance.py Horizons integration. See PRD §6 US-006.

title: evoi: Expected Value of Information ranking
description: Expected Value of Information: for each uncharacterized NEO, compute which observation (spectroscopy, radar, etc.) would most reduce scoring uncertainty. Rank by EVOI to answer 'which NEO should we observe next?' Uses Granvik prior + scorer to estimate posterior width reduction from hypothetical observations.

title: cnn-mineral-quantification: Stage 2B Korda et al. 2023
description: Stage 2B: Integrate Korda et al. (2023) CNN for modal abundances (OL/OPX/CPX) and chemistry (Fa, Fs, Wo) from VNIR spectra. Validate Asteroid-spectra repo works with current PyTorch. Only valid for S*-complex — enforce domain check. Report agreement/disagreement with classical band analysis as quality indicator. See PRD §4 Stage 2B.
